svg.desc: Two timelines over the same time window. With num_workers=0 the loop alternates loading a batch and training on it, finishing 4 steps. With two workers, batches are loaded in parallel ahead of time and the training loop runs 6 steps back to back without waiting.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Same model, same data. Only the input pipeline changes.
